templates.why_chosen: Minimalist variant: plain margin labels 'CNs' and 'MNs', not a boxed band, stand in for the compute/memory-pool split, while colored bold-italic headings (teal Pipeline Execution, red Cache Management) flag the paper's two named mechanisms.
templates.what_to_learn: When space is tight, replace the usual boxed interconnect band with a single margin label per tier (CNs / MNs) and rely on it alone to mark the boundary; reuse a bold-italic color per named technique (teal, red) across figures so a reader recognizes the same mechanism later without re-reading a legend.
